summary: Thursday title and cover pass: titles that ask a Why/How/What question about billionaires or the rich are our best Shorts, and a cast name in the title flopped. Added 3 global topics (one now tops the feed) and 1 title experiment proposal.
why: Since the reset, Shorts with Why/How/What titles have a median of 1,167 views vs 331 for the rest; 'Rohan gets paid $5,000' got 45 on day one. In the running title-names-the-moment test the 'on' arm has a median of 119 views vs 1,103 for 'off' (n=5 each, ages differ). The feed lacked a high-demand rich_vs_poor day-in-the-life topic (6.7M reference).
